pilot_gallery.rule: At most four seed17 queries per dataset, one per available original-relative state; fill absent states with distinct queries.
pilot_gallery.references: Actual fixed reference manifest; exclude identical ID/MMSI; first two same/rival class entries in bank order. No resizing.
pilot_gallery.limitation: Outcome-selected examples are not population proportions. Bank order is not learned attention ranking. No new per-reference attention trace or physical causal evidence.
pilot_gallery.prioritization: aligned-pooled top1 differences, then new-vs-CE differences, absolute margin differences, ID, order; deterministic.
